plan.name: Expose complete TLC graph data
plan.summary: Add a reusable internal/tlc graph parser and Runner.DumpGraph API that retain TLC fingerprint identities, exact TLA+ state labels and variable values, every initial state and every dumped source/action/target entry, including loops and parallel actions, before any dashboard compaction. Return a completed run's statistics, independently counted graph states and steps, a detached copy of its configuration and bounds, module name, Java image and actual jar SHA-256; reject malformed or incomplete DOT or completion evidence, inconsistent counts, failed runs, cancellation and missing or stale output. Isolate each dump's configuration and output, reuse the existing admission budget, memory limits and Docker cancellation cleanup, and preserve Runner.Dump's raw-DOT signature and dashboard behavior while adapting the existing Docker fakes to the selected paths without weakening their assertions. Cover the entire graph foundation in one plumbing pull request with pinned-format fixtures, refusal and lifecycle tests, dashboard compatibility, and a real pinned-TLC case wired into internal/verify's existing integration suite. Update SPEC.md with this issue's ratified plan and supporting citations to D-0016, D-0049, D-0105, D-0122 and D-0294, add a short README link to docs/statecharts.md, and describe the delivered bounded graph API, completeness checks, counts, provenance and test commands there without claiming proposal rendering; the new graph-evidence policy needs a decision recorded by the merger because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestGraph575PreservesDumpData
tests.says: The reusable parser preserves the pinned TLC DOT dialect's concrete identities, multiple initial states, each action-labeled step, exact structured values and large labels without sampling or deduplication.

tests.name: TestGraph575RefusesMalformedDOT
tests.says: Malformed, truncated, inconsistent or unlabeled graph records return an error and no graph.

tests.name: TestGraph575CompletedRunEvidence
tests.says: DumpGraph returns the completed TLC result, graph counts independently of generated states, configuration and actual tool provenance; the command retains the runner's resource and isolation settings.

tests.name: TestGraph575RefusesIncompleteRuns
tests.says: Missing completion records, unfinished queues, inconsistent state, initial-state or step counts, tool failures and malformed output cannot return graph evidence, even after a success message.

tests.name: TestGraph575IsolatesOutputAndKeepsDumpCompatible
tests.says: Each invocation consumes only its own regular output, refuses old or absent dumps and preserves the legacy raw-DOT caller contract and caller files.

tests.name: TestGraph575AdmissionAndCancellation
tests.says: Graph runs share the TLC admission budget, preserve cancellation causes, join container cleanup before releasing capacity and never publish a canceled run's graph.

tests.name: TestGraph575DashboardCompatibility
tests.says: The new graph retains the same states, initials, actions and labels as the existing dashboard fixture, preserves trace behavior, and stays complete when a separate dashboard graph is compacted.

tests.name: TestGraph575PinnedTLC
tests.says: The offline pinned-format fixture exercises the new API on every run; INVARIANT_TLC_GRAPH_REAL=1 also checks a model with multiple initial states, structured values, loops and parallel actions against the checksum-verified pinned TLC, and the new integration-tagged TestGraph575RealIntegration calls graph575Real for the existing CI integration shards.
